text: Generally like the app and paid för Lifetime sub, but seriously, they have Strava sync for running but it's impossible to set a higher goal yearly than 500 km. Who runs only 500 km in a whole year???
author: Peter Fransson
developer_reply: Hi Peter—sorry about the Strava yearly goal cap (500 km). Thanks for your feedback, and for Lifetime support. Please email contact@habitify.me so we can help. You can also suggest/vote at feedback.habitify.me.
